bias.zh: 中性 · 收复 $146，仍在均线下方

read.en: SpaceX rose 1.9% on Oct 23 to $147.49, trading between $144.09 and $149.74, with no 100-day average yet (93 sessions). It is below the falling 5-day ($149.5), 10-day ($151.4) and 30-day ($153.4) averages. MACD has been below its signal since Oct 14 and is now below zero; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 14 ($168.26), and RSI is 46.
read.zh: SpaceX 10月23日上涨 1.9%，收于 $147.49，盘中区间 $144.09–149.74；上市仅 93 个交易日，尚无 100 日均线。股价位于下行的 5 日（$149.5）、10 日（$151.4）和 30 日均线（$153.4）下方。MACD 自 10月14日起位于信号线下方，现已跌破零轴；抛物线 SAR 自 10月14日起看空（$168.26），RSI 为 46。

read.en: The close reclaimed the $145.4–147.1 zone (Sep 28 and Jun 23 lows), support again. Resistance is $149.5–149.8, then $151.4–154.3 (10 and 30-day, Oct 22 high) and $166.2 (Oct 21 high). Support is $145.4–147.1, then $142.9–144.1 (Sep 15, Oct 22 and 23 lows) and $140.7 (Oct 15 low). A close above $149.8 would target $151–154; a close below $142.9 would open $140.7.

s.en: Sep 15 low $142.9; Oct 22 low $143.2; Oct 23 low $144.1
